notes.title: Widescreen Support arrives!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We've finally added widescreen support for (probably) all possible aspect ratios! Let us know if you still have issues with yours!
[*] Other minor bug fixes (dev features were previously still enabled, we have no idea how we let that slip through)
[/list]

P.S.: Some content based on images (like level transitions or the main menu) will still have black borders, due to their static nature. The in-game experience will fully support widescreen, though!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.0.1[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the option to [spoiler]take your own life[/spoiler] at the end of the game would not trigger correctly and freeze the game.
[*] Fixed a bug when sometimes, the checkpoint after [spoiler]dying 3 times[/spoiler] would be incorrectly set to a different location.
[*] Solved an issue where story information was revealed to the player in certain situations, even if the player did not satisfy the requirements needed.
[*] Minor story consistency adjustments.
[/list]
